versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "embodied-ai-jobs" skill for weekly tracking of embodied AI industry job and internship opportunities.
- Automatically collects and organizes openings across software, hardware, algorithm, product, and research roles from company sites, recruitment platforms, and WeChat accounts.
- Outputs structured weekly reports in Markdown (primary) and optional HTML formats, including statistical summaries and key highlights.
- Supports automatic scheduling for continuous updates and provides clear classification of companies and roles.
